name: Diaphragmatic Breathing Supine

instructions.description: Lie on your back with knees bent or legs supported in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on your chest and one hand on your abdomen.
Inhale slowly through the nose so the lower hand rises more than the upper hand.
Exhale gently through the mouth or nose and let the abdomen soften before repeating.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use relaxed repeated breaths for the planned interval.
Focus on slow nasal inhalation and relaxed prolonged exhalation.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Practice the same breath pattern in an upright sitting posture.

commentsNotes: The breath should feel smooth rather than forced.
